orientation: row 0 = north, column 0 = east (north up, east left when drawn top-down)
dtype: float32, little-endian, NaN = no valid data
background: per-frame sigma-clipped median subtracted (value in frames[].bg)

source.archive: NASA/IPAC IRSA, SPHEREx Level 2 spectral image cutouts

flag_descriptions.15: Nonlinearity correction cannot be applied reliably

flag_descriptions.23: Affected by a bright source on another detector
flag_descriptions.24: Pixel affected by a bright source outside FOV
